name: Spin
summary: A brand-coloured spinner for an indeterminate wait — loading a page, a panel, or results.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-spin> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; the ring is a pure-CSS rotation (no inline <svg>, no icon), so it never blocks on the registry. `size` scales it (small/default/large) and `tip` adds a caption. Zero drift.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin attribute wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

props.name: tip
props.desc: Optional caption shown under the ring

whenToUse.when: an indeterminate wait with no measurable percentage
you want to hold the shape of the content that is loading

opinion.note: Reach for Spin only when you cannot show a percentage or hold the layout. Keep one spinner per waiting region; pair it with a short tip for waits over ~1s.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — DS V3 has no measured Spin cell; spec derived from the token layer (head color-primary, track purple-20) and antd Spin conventions (rotating ring, small/default/large). A deliberate, documented extension.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render.
